snippet.title: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-Bit - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🖥️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445490/Angry_Video_Game_Nerd_8bit
🔴 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/angry-video-game-nerd-8-bit-switch/
🔵 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014313
🟢 Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/angry-video-game-nerd-8-bit/9NS3V2J019FX/0010
Physical Pre-order is now OVER!!

The Angry Video Game Nerd 8-Bit is ready-to-play with a brand-new free demo on Steam! Play through two action-packed levels inspired by classic retro-style gameplay and packed with signature AVGN humor. Blast through the Graveyard and Soda Factory levels, face off against iconic enemies, and relive the Nerd’s most legendary battles! Wishlist now on Steam and stay tuned for physical editions from Limited Run Games (NES cartridge manufacturing by Mega Cat Studios.) 🔥

Game Developed for NES by Mega Cat Studios
https://megacatstudios.com
https://x.com/megacatstudios

PC Version Developed by Programancer
https://programancer.carrd.co
https://x.com/Programancer

Published by Retroware
https://retroware.com/
https://x.com/retroware

Retroware Main Staff
Studio Head - Ryan Schott
Creative Director - Justin Silverman
Art Director - Xander Arnot

Game Key-art and Thumbnail by Philip Summers
https://linktr.ee/handdrawngaming
